purpose: Teach: 抹殺/卑劣/撃退/狙撃/弛緩/摂理/拘置/朝方

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、政治家の抹殺事件史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, your paper on the assassination of politicians caught my attention.
lines.style: Measured, conversational opening. Gentle curiosity in her tone—not interrogation, genuine interest. Warm eye contact. She's drawing her out.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、卑劣な手段で勝利した戦例を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes. I focused on military victories achieved through dishonorable means.
lines.style: Direct, steady response. No hesitation or defensiveness. Speaking clearly about a topic she's thought through carefully. Slight uplift at the end—confident in her choice.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 侵略軍の撃退史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you examined histories of repelling invading forces.
lines.style: Following the thread thoughtfully. Not a question exactly—more like she's reflecting back what she's reading. Slower pace. Genuinely curious where this leads.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、要人狙撃事件を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes. I looked specifically at assassination attempts on key figures.
lines.style: Calm certainty. She's not flinching from the subject matter. Meeting the teacher's eye. Steady, almost defiant in her directness.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 神経の弛緩反応を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Your work on nerve responses under stress—that was striking.
lines.style: Noticing something beneath the surface. A slight pause before 'striking.' She's recognized Sakura has been thinking about something real. Warm, not clinical.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、神の摂理を巡る宗教思想を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes. I explored religious philosophy around divine will and providence.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost introspective. She's settling into deeper ground now. Slower cadence. This part mattered to her, and it shows in how carefully she frames it.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦時下の拘置所制度を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And detention systems during wartime—you covered that too.
lines.style: Connecting pieces together quietly. Tone shifts slightly toward something more serious. She's piecing something together about what Sakura was really investigating.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、朝方の交通事故統計を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes. I analyzed early-morning traffic accident statistics and their patterns.
lines.style: Still direct, but there's weight now. She knows what she's saying. The clinical subject matter is deliberate. Slight fade at the end—leaving space for the teacher to understand.
